subject.title: Workspaces: add version history and exact restore

question: Should OpenClaw adopt workspace history as a supported Workspaces feature and expose these three synchronous Kysely helpers as permanent public plugin SDK API?
rationale: The restoration implementation is bounded, but accepting a new user-facing audit surface and an external plugin API contract is a product and compatibility choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve focused feature and SDK
options.body: Accept workspace history and the three focused plugin-state helpers, then require a clean rebase, green i18n, and live browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep helpers bundled-only
options.body: Keep the feature but rework SQLite access through an approved bundled-plugin internal facade so the public SDK does not expand.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open and defer this branch until Workspaces history and SDK direction have explicit sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Approve focused feature and SDK
recommendation.body: Accept workspace history and the three focused plugin-state helpers, then require a clean rebase, green i18n, and live browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice sets product scope and a durable external plugin SDK contract, requiring repository-level ownership rather than contributor-only follow-up.
